description: This Java source file defines the GatewayAuthenticationDirective class, which provides an Akka HTTP directive for performing authentication in a gateway service. It manages authentication chains, handles request context extraction, and applies authentication results to routing.

classes.name: GatewayAuthenticationDirective
classes.description: Provides an Akka HTTP directive to perform authentication for incoming requests in a gateway service, managing authentication chains and handling success or failure scenarios.

methods.name: GatewayAuthenticationDirective
methods.description: Constructor initializing with an authentication chain and a default unauthorized exception factory.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Performs authentication using request headers and applies the inner route if successful.

methods.name: handleAuthenticationTry
methods.description: Processes the result of the authentication attempt, routing to the inner route on success or handling failure.

methods.name: handleFailedAuthentication
methods.description: Handles failed authentication attempts by logging and throwing appropriate exceptions.
